tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides game-theoretic attribution with strong interpretability for tabular models. LIME offers local interpretability using a surrogate model, integrating with diverse feature distributions. Integrated Gradients compute gradients from a baseline, capturing continuous impact. Sensitivity analysis directly measures feature impact through ablation, offering a rigorous validation of importance. Together, these tools yield a well-rounded, statistically grounded, and domain-relevant feature attribution for tabular data.
